name: Alga Investigation Sync
description: Synchronizes Mattermost thread replies with Alga investigation records by forwarding thread activity to the Alga webhook endpoint.

settings_schema.header: Configure the Alga Investigation Sync plugin to forward Mattermost thread replies to your Alga backend. The **Webhook Secret** is used for both inbound and outbound communication — copy it to the `MATTERMOST_WEBHOOK_SECRET` setting in Alga.

settings.help_text: The URL of the Alga webhook endpoint (e.g., `https://alga.example.com/webhooks/mattermost`)

Shared secret for authenticating requests. Used for both inbound webhook forwarding (plugin → Alga) and outbound API calls (Alga → plugin). Must match the token configured in Alga (`MATTERMOST_WEBHOOK_SECRET`).
